## B. Drift checklist

1. Operation ↔ data-model *(core)* — ✓. Every operation reads or writes at least one entity. The exception is `startSignIn`, a stateless OIDC redirect whose PKCE verifier lives in a short-lived cookie. It was accepted as is (F8).
2. Problem type ↔ repo error definition *(core)* — ✓ (deferred: the codes are this contract's proposal; `governance` has only `ErrMeetingNotFound`, and handlers emit `about:blank` until `implement-tasks` maps the sentinels in `adapters/http`, D8).
3. Validation ↔ constraint *(core)* — ✓. Every `VARCHAR(N)` becomes `maxLength: N`, `SMALLINT` becomes 0..32767, `DATE` becomes `format: date`, `TIMESTAMPTZ` becomes `format: date-time`, and named enums use the data-model values verbatim. The staged DDL has no CHECKs (course rules), so the contract is stricter only where the PRD says so: `minLength: 1` on NOT NULL text the PRD calls "missing", `minimum: 1` on amounts and register numbers, file ≤ 20 MB. Three unbounded text fields have no column bound: `message` (TEXT), `corrections_note` (TEXT) and `reason` (jsonb).
4. Entity / AC / §10 refusal ↔ operation coverage *(supporting)* — ✓ (deferred: AC-01 and AC-08 lack the election-protocol source and US-01 lacks the charter rules, D1, D2; the Google-account connection of ADR 0004 has no operation, D3). Every other Stage 1 AC maps to an operation (table below), and every §10 refusal maps to a 403 or 409.
5. OpenAPI ↔ sequence, sequence gaps *(supporting)* — ✓ (deferred: sequence gaps listed below, D5). No §6 message names an HTTP verb, path or status. SAD §6 says so explicitly.
6. PRD §5.1 catalogue ↔ problem types *(core)* — ✓. All 17 Stage 1 codes appear under the status their kind maps to. 8 codes are added beyond §5.1, each with a source (D4). The membership 403 is `governance.not_board_member` in both PRD.ao-prd §5.1 and SAD.ao §8 / ADR 0022, so there is no flag. The other pair (sad.md ADR-0003, `contracts/`) uses `identity.not_current_member`; see the merge notes.
7. Lists ↔ cursor parameters and page *(core)* — ✓. `listBoardMembers`, `listCases`, `listProtocols`, `listAssistantTurns`, `listPollRounds` and `searchRegistry` take `Limit` + `Cursor`, answer `<Entity>Page {items, next_cursor}` and declare 422. `RegistryEntryPage` adds `withdrawn_numbers` (AC-36 gaps; merge note). There is no offset, `before` or `has_prev`. Nested arrays (`Case.documents`, `Protocol.agenda_items`, `DecisionSlot.values`) are bounded parts of one aggregate and not paged.
8. Tag ↔ context ↔ path prefix, unique operationId *(core)* — ✓. One tag per operation, and every path starts with `/identity/` or `/governance/`. The 34 operationIds are unique, with none of the repo's 7 (`getHealth`, `createContract`, `listContracts`, `getContract`, `createMeeting`, `listMeetings`, `getMeeting`) reused. `identity` is a new context, and its wiring checklist is in section E.
9. Delta ↔ repo contract, scratch codegen *(core)* — ✓. `Currency`, `Problem`, `FieldError`, `NotFound` and `UnprocessableEntity` are byte-for-byte copies, and no repo schema changes. There are no inline object schemas (only primitives and arrays of `$ref`). Every operation has an operationId. Scratch oapi-codegen + `go build` + `go vet` pass for both tags, and orval passes too.

## E. Merge notes for services/core/api/openapi.yaml

- **New tags:** `identity`. New context wiring (CLAUDE.md, SAD.ao §5): `identity` tag in the spec · `internal/identity/adapters/http/gen/oapi-codegen.yaml` (`include-tags: [identity]`) · `sqlc.yaml` entry · `identity-private` depguard rule in `.golangci.yml` (and the `(system|finance|governance|identity)-private` exclusion pattern) · `identity.New(pool, governance)` in `cmd/api/main.go`.
- **New components:** schemas `Session`, `AssociationSettings`, `SaveAssociationSettingsRequest`, `BoardMember`, `NewBoardMember`, `BoardMemberPage`, `SetMeetingChairRequest`, `FileMediaType`, `StoredFile`, `FileContent`, `Case`, `NewCase`, `CasePage`, `CaseDocument`, `AddCaseDocumentRequest`, `ProtocolState`, `AssistantStatus`, `ProtocolSummary`, `ProtocolPage`, `Protocol`, `NewProtocol`, `AddAgendaItemRequest`, `AskAssistantRequest`, `AssistantTurnRole`, `AssistantTurn`, `AssistantTurnPage`, `AgendaItem`, `Fragment`, `TextFragment`, `SlotFragment`, `MeetingFragment`, `MeetingFragmentField`, `SaveAgendaItemWordingRequest`, `SlotKind`, `SlotStatus`, `SlotOrigin`, `SlotCurrency`, `DecisionSlot`, `SlotValue`, `SlotValueInput`, `SlotConfirmation`, `AddDecisionSlotRequest`, `ConfirmDecisionSlotRequest`, `CorrectDecisionSlotRequest`, `ProtocolTransitionRequest`, `WithdrawProtocolRequest`, `CopyProtocolRequest`, `PollChoice`, `PollNotice`, `PollRound`, `PollTally`, `PollVote`, `PollRoundPage`, `CastPollVoteRequest`, `PrintCopyStatus`, `PrintCopy`, `MeetingItemVote`, `MeetingFactsInput`, `MeetingFacts`, `SignProtocolRequest`, `RegistryEntry`, `RegistryEntryPage`; responses `Conflict`, `Forbidden`, `Unauthorized`, `ServiceUnavailable`; `components/parameters` (new section: `Limit`, `Cursor` and 7 path ids; the repo's own list operations keep their inline params); `components/examples`; `securitySchemes.SessionCookie`.
- **Changed repo components:** none. `Meeting` / `NewMeeting` stay as they are: `meetings.association_id` is internal, and `chair_board_member_id` is written by `setMeetingChair` and read through `Protocol`.
- **Security:** `SessionCookie` and the global `security` are added. Every existing operation (`finance` contracts, `governance` meetings) becomes protected: give `/system/health` `security: []` at merge, and add 401 `Unauthorized` / 403 `Forbidden` to `createContract`, `listContracts`, `getContract`, `createMeeting`, `listMeetings` and `getMeeting` (`RequireMember` wraps both groups, SAD.ao §5).
- **Handler methods to add:** identity: `StartSignIn`, `CompleteSignIn`, `SignOut`, `GetSession`. governance: `GetAssociationSettings`, `SaveAssociationSettings`, `ListBoardMembers`, `CreateBoardMember`, `ReviseBoardMember`, `SetMeetingChair`, `ListCases`, `CreateCase`, `GetCase`, `AddCaseDocument`, `DownloadFile`, `ListProtocols`, `CreateProtocolDraft`, `GetProtocol`, `AddAgendaItem`, `ListAssistantTurns`, `AskAssistant`, `SaveAgendaItemWording`, `AddDecisionSlot`, `ConfirmDecisionSlot`, `CorrectDecisionSlot`, `ListPollRounds`, `StartPollRound`, `CastPollVote`, `ReturnProtocolToDraft`, `MarkProtocolReadyForSigning`, `SignProtocol`, `WithdrawProtocol`, `CopyProtocol`, `SearchRegistry`.
- **Problem types handlers must emit instead of about:blank:** `identity.session_required`, `governance.not_board_member` (from the `identity` middleware; `internal/platform/httpapi`), and `governance.{association_settings_missing, source_document_required, meeting_not_found, protocol_not_found, amount_unconfirmed, draft_changed, vote_on_behalf, voting_not_open, meeting_facts_required, corrections_note_required, signed_copy_invalid, protocol_locked, transition_not_allowed, register_start_locked, storage_unavailable}` + the 8 of D4. Validator 422s and router 404/405s keep `about:blank`.
- **Against `contracts/` (sdlc:api-forge, same feature):** both have 34 operations. This delta differs in four ways. (1) The membership 403 is `governance.not_board_member` (PRD.ao §5.1, ADR 0022), not `identity.not_current_member`, and the stale-revision 409 is `governance.draft_changed`, not `governance.draft_revision_conflict`. (2) It has no `/governance/jobs/*` endpoints: job state is a field of the resource (`assistant_status`, `PrintCopy.status`). (3) It has no separate signed-protocol read: `getProtocol` serves every state from the snapshot. (4) Problem types are `urn:problem:` URNs with no `code` extension member. Whichever contract is merged needs one canonical PRD/SAD pair first (SAD.ao §11 risk "Two SADs").
